name: viewport-mercator-project
description: Utilities for perspective-enabled Web Mercator projections
author: Uber Technologies, Inc.

scripts.clean: rm -fr dist && mkdir -p dist/es5 dist/esm dist/es6
scripts.lint: eslint src test examples && npm run lint-yarn
scripts.lint-yarn: !(grep -q unpm.u yarn.lock) || (echo 'Please rebuild yarn file using public npmrc' && false)
scripts.publish-prod: npm run build && npm run test && npm publish
scripts.publish-beta: npm run build && npm run test && npm publish --tag beta
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test-node && ./scripts/build.sh
